_doc: 4G modem self-test (INK_SELFTEST_CELL): our NT26 driver against the modem model; every CHECK must pass.

test.fail.why: a modem self-test CHECK failed (see warnings)

test.pass.why: fewer modem checks ran than expected

modem.slot_changes.why: the four card switches did not all reach the modem

modem.resets.why: the modem reset was not modelled
